riad-jardin-secret.author: Khadija
riad-jardin-secret.body: I had an amazing stay at Fouad’s apartment in Marrakech, Morocco! The place was spotless, stylish, and even better than the photos. It had everything I needed for a comfortable stay from a fully equipped kitchen to a cozy, peaceful bedroom. The location was perfect, close to the main attractions yet quiet and relaxing. Fouad was an exceptional host friendly, responsive, and genuinely caring. He gave great local recommendations and made sure everything was perfect during my stay. I felt completely at home and safe. This apartment truly exceeded my expectations in every way.…

riad-jardin-secret.author: Mashari
riad-jardin-secret.body: Honestly, I’ve rented many apartments in Morocco, and this was by far the best experience. Everything was perfect, and I’ll definitely stay here again every time I visit Marrakech.

riad-jardin-secret.author: Ebony
riad-jardin-secret.body: Wonderful place to stay , host was always responsive and easy to check in

riad-jardin-secret.author: K
riad-jardin-secret.body: Absolutely spot on a top host definitely would book again highly recommend

riad-jardin-secret.author: Iris
riad-jardin-secret.body: Thank you Mohammed, It was a perfect Apartment for the first night. Perfect communication via Whats App. Thank you 🙏

riad-jardin-secret.author: Salma
riad-jardin-secret.body: A great stay at Adil's, in a wonderful location in Gueliz. Adil was a quick to communicate and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay. I highly recommend staying at his apartment!!

riad-jardin-secret.author: Naif
riad-jardin-secret.body: No matter what you are looking for in Marrakesh, this is the right place for it

riad-jardin-secret.author: Abir
riad-jardin-secret.body: The apartment was perfect with literally no downside. I was looking for a clean apartment near airport and Mohamed’s apartment was the perfect choice. I have been using Airbnb listings for the past 10 years and I have never seen a well equipped place as this one. We had coffee, tea and bottles of water on top of some snacks. Mohamed was very responsive and shared clear instructions for the online check-in.…

riad-jardin-secret.author: Abdessamad
riad-jardin-secret.body: I had a great stay at Hamza’s apartment. The place is very comfortable and clean. It's equipped with everything you need, even for a long stay. The apartment is calm and relaxing, making it perfect for resting after a busy day. Hamza is an exceptionally kind host. He was always available, very responsive, and made sure everything went smoothly from reservation to checkout. His attention and hospitality truly made the experience even better.

riad-jardin-secret.author: Fayçal
riad-jardin-secret.body: Adil's place can only be described as perfect, it is spacious, easy to find, in a calm neighborhood, plus a very nice and helpful doorman, adil was extremely responsive, and always eager to help, i would recommend this place to anyone coming to Marrakech, this is a rare gem, and a bargain, i couldn't get enough of it, since i felt like home, i will be back for sure 😊

riad-jardin-secret.author: Ilham
riad-jardin-secret.body: Très belle expérience dans cet appartement à Marrakech. Le logement est confortable, très propre et idéalement situé. Tout est neuf et moderne, ce qui rend le séjour encore plus agréable, avec l’impression d’être l’un des premiers occupants. Je recommande sans hésitation

riad-jardin-secret.author: Mohamed El Amine
riad-jardin-secret.body: Séjour parfait ! L’appartement est lumineux, propre et très bien équipé. On s’y sent immédiatement à l’aise. L’hôte, quant à lui, est d’une grande gentillesse et toujours disponible, ce qui rend l’expérience encore plus agréable. Merci pour cette hospitalité, je recommande vivement !

villa-palmeraie-oasis.author: Hamidou
villa-palmeraie-oasis.body: Everything was great overall. The room looked exactly as on the listing and Adbessamad was very nice and friendly. I’m grateful and thankful for the fact that he accepted me in his family home.

villa-palmeraie-oasis.author: Mick
villa-palmeraie-oasis.body: Yassine is a great host. Made me feel right at home in his lovely place, very traditional. In the old part of the city, it comes with what you expect, the neighbourhood is lived in, as it has been for hundreds of years. The neighbourhood is lively, after all you're in Marrakech. If the nights are warm and you have the window open expect the street noise. Ear plugs should sort it out, or just stay out late and enjoy the vibe. Light breakfast at 9am on the roof terrace is nice as well. The Square is a 15min walk. Taxis will pick up at door if you give them a drop pin or location.…

villa-palmeraie-oasis.author: Éric
villa-palmeraie-oasis.body: Excellent ! Superbe nuit. Super sympa, patient ! Chambre très agréable, je recommande !

villa-palmeraie-oasis.author: Danish
villa-palmeraie-oasis.body: Yassine’s place was nice and clean but the neighbourhood was quite slurry. And considering the cold there was no arrangement of heating. Atleast there should be some arrangement of hot water in winters. But the lady there was very welcoming and she attended us very well.

villa-palmeraie-oasis.author: Matéo
villa-palmeraie-oasis.body: Endroit très sympathique, Yassine répond vite aux messages, très réactif. Une chambre très conforme aux photos, un petit déjeuné excellent en terrasse. Si besoin d’informations ou de questionnement sur la ville, il sera vous répondre. J’ai passé un excellent séjour dans ce Riad, je vous le recommande sans hésitation !

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Ahmed
gueliz-modern-loft.body: If you are looking for luxury and high-end care, choose this apartment.. because in short it is the best apartment in Marrakech.. They paid attention to every detail from the high-end furniture and all the home appliances are also high-end and it will be my first choice when I visit Marrakech again.. Thank you very much

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Antonio
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Really good location and the host is awesome, he is always there to help and responds very quickly. The apartment is very modern clean and the balcony is nice too! For big people, the shower might be a little bit small.

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Abdellah
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Really enjoyed my stay. The place was clean and comfortable, and the host was easy to communicate with. Everything went smoothly. Would definitely recommend.

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Kim
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Lahoucine is the absolute best host we've ever had in Morroco. He was proactive and genuinely cares about the guest experience. We had an early flight out and he even awoke at 5:30a to be available via messaging to ensure we got off ok. He also helped us coordinate our transfer to the airport. Top notch service and excellent value in the apartment. Everything is very well taken care of.

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Oumaima
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Séjour très agréable dans l’appartement. Tout était conforme à l’annonce : propre, confortable et bien situé. La communication avec l’hôte a été fluide et sympathique. Merci pour l’accueil, je recommande sans hésiter

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Reysie
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Hamza was great. The place is really nice. We enjoyed our time here. Would definitely book it again.

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Ka
gueliz-modern-loft.body: leuke rustige locatie met een mooi uitzicht op een berg. in de buurt zijn winkels en eetgelegenheden. de bushalte naar het centrum is op loopafstand

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Yinan
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Magnificent room and very nice stay! It’s also very smooth to communicate with Adil!

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Guillaume
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Great stay! The apartment was very clean and well equipped and match the photos on the listing description and even better than the photos. The host was welcoming, and the Moroccan sweets were a lovely touch. Everything was perfect we had a great time. Highly recommended.

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Luna
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Me and my parents had an amazing stay! The area is calm , the home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Alhoucine was a wonderful host—kind, welcoming, and always ready to help. I truly appreciated the warm hospitality. Highly recommend this place!

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Jay-Dean
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Hamza was a great and friendly host. He was welcoming and responded very quickly. The place itself is awesome. Nothing to complain about at all. Would definitely stay again.😁

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Youmna
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Very clean and welcoming place. I had a great stay and would definitely recommend it!

gueliz-modern-loft.author: Zohra
gueliz-modern-loft.body: Hamza est très accueillant, chaleureux et toujours disponible pour aider. Je me suis senti comme chez moi dès mon arrivée et il a fait tout son possible pour rendre mon séjour parfait. Je recommande vivement, vous pouvez réserver les yeux fermés ☺️🙏

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Lahcen
riad-medina-rooftop.body: I had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. The location was perfect, close to everything I needed, yet peaceful and quiet. Zaho was incredibly kind and responsive, making check-in super easy and ensuring I had everything I needed throughout my stay. I truly felt at home and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. I’d love to come back again — thank you for such a wonderful experience! 🌿✨

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Ahsan
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Beautiful, comfortable and convenient apartment right by the city! Would certainly recommend.

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Evan
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Great spot for a great price. Great host as well, very responsive, helpful and kind. Highly recommend staying here!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Alex
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Mo is a great host, very kind and responsive! Would stay here again 100%, great accommodation!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Abdelkarim
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Compact but super functional flat in a quiet, secure building (CCTV and night guard!). The host was very helpful and responsive. Great value for the price, highly recommend for anyone needing a practical stay near the city center!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Amanda
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Mohamed’s place was 10/10! Exactly how it was described and the pictures do not do this place justice! I love the finishing touches and when I checked in there was readily made tea and some lovely biscuits. Mohamed was a great host, very responsive and proactive - thank you for allowing me into your home!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Maryam
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Loved my stay here. The apartment extremely clean, cozy and beautifully decorated. The location was great pretty close to everything and the apartment itself was very spacious. If im ever back in marrakesh I will definitely stay here again!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Utku
riad-medina-rooftop.body: The apartment is just like in the pictures and the gaming console there is just making it incredible place! There is so much games you can try in there which mean whenever you are tired of the city you can just come here and play games together! The place was clean and as described. It had all the amenities that was described. Recommended!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Mo
riad-medina-rooftop.body: 5 star review for Mohamed, very welcoming and friendly host. Responsive and helpful, clean and spacious apartment, perfect for my stay. Host also went out of his way and provided tea and snacks which was a nice touch. Would recommend!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Ilham
riad-medina-rooftop.body: We had an amazing stay at Lahoucine’s place. The unit was very clean, cozy, and truly felt like home. We were two adults and two children, and the space was perfectly comfortable for us. We especially appreciated the heating, which wasn’t available in any of the other rentals we booked, during the cold weather, it was a real blessing. Thank you, Lahoucine, for being such a great host. We highly recommend this place to future travelers!

riad-medina-rooftop.author: Nahid
riad-medina-rooftop.body: Great place, clean and beautifully designed. The host was more than helpful and attentive with clear instructions and follow up.

villa-atlas-views.author: Gian
villa-atlas-views.body: the host is a wonderful person, and his family helps you with everything; they make you feel at home. everything is very clean, spotless — truly, everything was wonderful.

villa-atlas-views.author: Lente Verde
villa-atlas-views.body: El alojamiento estuvo muy bien, Omar me ayudó a llegar porque mi taxista no encontraba el sitio, él se comunicó con el taxista y le dio indicaciones . Mi internet tuvo problemas y no podía encontrar la info, y Omar me ayudó a entrar. Excelente anfitrión

villa-atlas-views.author: Nikolai
villa-atlas-views.body: Liebe Menschen, schöner Ausblick von der Dachterrasse nur nachts bleib es eben laut. Wenn man bei viel Geräusch gut schlafen kann sehr zu empfehlen. Ansonsten empfiehlt es sich vielleicht einen ruhigeres Hostel zu suchen.

villa-atlas-views.author: Sebastián
villa-atlas-views.body: Fue una experiencia muy auténtica, la señora que nos recibió es demasiado amable y nos daba comida típica, 100% recomendado

villa-atlas-views.author: Emma
villa-atlas-views.body: Ich hatte einen wirklich tollen Aufenthalt in diesem neuen Airbnb. Alles war sehr sauber, modern eingerichtet und genau wie in der Beschreibung. Besonders hervorheben möchte ich die Mitarbeiter bzw. Gastgeber – sie waren durchgehend sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und haben sich wirklich Mühe gegeben, dass man sich willkommen fühlt. Der Check-in lief unkompliziert und bei Fragen wurde schnell reagiert. Man merkt, dass hier viel Wert auf Gastfreundschaft gelegt wird. Ich kann diese Unterkunft definitiv weiterempfehlen und würde jederzeit wiederkommen🥰

villa-atlas-views.author: Kelly
villa-atlas-views.body: Room and bath were clean. Yassine was respectful and helpful. 20 min walk to the Jemaa el-Fnaa market and 8min away to small restaurants and shops in a less crowded area. I had a good time at this Airbnb. My only difficulty was perhaps the hard mattress but that might be a subjective matter.

villa-atlas-views.author: Rose
villa-atlas-views.body: Khalil was very nice and accommodating. The room had everything I needed for a short stay and communication was smooth. I would highly recommend :)

villa-atlas-views.author: Smilja
villa-atlas-views.body: This is my second time staying with Fatimazahra and will be back again. She is a true gem! Love the set up in this house where everything makes sense and works well, from the room, to the kitchen, the patio, the neighborhood, the internet, and most of all the host. If you are looking for a great and comfortable place to relax or stay long-term as a digital nomad, you will have a wonderful bed, a convenient location, a fantastic connection, and two terraces to enjoy the wonderful Marrakech sun. Thanks woman !

villa-atlas-views.author: Azeddine
villa-atlas-views.body: Great stay with a wonderful host. Definitely gonna book again.

villa-atlas-views.author: Bouchaib
villa-atlas-views.body: Un séjour qui s’est extrêmement bien déroulé et en grande partie grâce à madame Mariam, un hôte très impliqué, gentil et réactif qui a su rendre notre séjour inoubliable à force de gentillesse et proposition d’activité. Je conseil et on y reviendra sûrement.

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Ibrahim
kasbah-style-apartment.body: It was excellent location and car park is available safe area Also, Fuad was supported.

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Lianne
kasbah-style-apartment.body: A really lovely apartment with a very friendly and accomodating host. It is clean, bright and just as it seems in the photos, plus the shower is lovely - which I always think is a bonus! I would highly recommend this place, you will be very comfortable here

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Curt
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Adil was quick and clear with his communications and instructions. Everything was as described and in the pictures. It can be tricky to find for cab drivers for some reason so make sure to use google maps or have it saved before you go so you don’t get dropped off a few blocks away and have to walk. Not the fault of Adil and doesn’t take away from his great place, just a word of advice to make the experience easier. Definitely recommend Adil and his apartment!

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Adewale
kasbah-style-apartment.body: When ever I visit Marrakech again I will definitely book in this place again and again and I will refer to my family and friends coming soon

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Pare
kasbah-style-apartment.body: me and my friends loved this place! super clean and super comfy:)

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Elyas
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Our stay at this Marrakech apartment was wonderful. It was clean, comfortable, and stylishly decorated, offering a perfect base for exploring the city. The location was excellent, putting us close to everything while still being peaceful.

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Julie
kasbah-style-apartment.body: An amazing modern flat with everything you need. Amenities close by in a quiet area. A responsive and friendly host. Highly recommended ☺️

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Ben
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Lovely apartment, which was ideally located for me being close to local restaurants and cafes, and about a 35 minute walk to Jemaa El-Fna. Check in was simple, and the apartment was spotlessly clean and a couple of bottles of water in the fridge which was appreciated.

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Ismaeel
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Zoha was great - very quick to respond an helped us with everything. The Apartment was amazing and modern and with an PS5

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Kamil
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Un immense merci à Nael pour cette expérience absolument parfaite. L’appartement est magnifique, décoré avec beaucoup de goût, d’une propreté irréprochable et idéalement situé. On s’y sent tout de suite comme chez soi. Nael est un hôte extrêmement réactif, d’une gentillesse rare et toujours attentif au moindre détail pour que le séjour se passe au mieux. Nous avons passé un séjour exceptionnel et, sans aucun doute, nous avons trouvé notre nouvelle adresse à Marrakech. Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir.

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Chadi
kasbah-style-apartment.body: I had a great stay at Lahoucine ‘s appartement , very clean place , comfy , secure free parking for the car , Lahoucine is a great person , the communication was great , I

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Majda
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Un séjour vraiment agréable ! L’appartement est magnifique, propre très relaxant et parfaitement situé, tout près des restaurants, snacks et du supermarché Marjane. Je reviendrai avec grand plaisir. Merci pour tout

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Hajar
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Amazing stay, super clean and great service Highly recommend

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Bouchra
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Nuestra estancia ha sido fantástica. El piso es precioso, con mucha luz y una decoración con toques de Marrakech de muy buen gusto. Todo estaba impecable y, algo que valoramos mucho, olía de maravilla al entrar. ​La ubicación es inmejorable si necesitas estar cerca del aeropuerto, ya que se llega andando en unos 15 minutos. Pero lo mejor, sin duda, ha sido el trato: el dueño es majísimo y nos ayudó con todas nuestras dudas al momento. Incluso su padre fue encantador con nosotros. Nos hemos sentido como en casa. Totalmente recomendable

kasbah-style-apartment.author: Matthew
kasbah-style-apartment.body: Great place in a great location. Cheap ride away from the busy city. Everything you need to have a great stay!

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Latifa
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: We really enjoyed our stay at Ismail’s place. The flat is right in the center of Gueliz, so it’s super convenient for exploring the city of Marrakech. It’s very clean, beautifully decorated, and most importantly, really quiet which is perfect for relaxing after a day out. Ismail was very responsive and even let us check in early, which we really appreciated. We would definitely stay here again.

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Shaheed
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: Mohammed was a great host, I would definitely stay with him again. The apartment was conveniently located and very clean.

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Amine
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: We had a great stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive and welcoming, and everything we needed was provided. The location was convenient and quiet, making it a perfect place to relax. Definitely worth the stay,would happily come back!

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Topi
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: Apartment was very nice and clean. Everything worked just like it should.

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Ping
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: Our stay in Marrakech was amazing! The apartment is extremely clean and well stocked- everything we needed was provided. It also felt very safe, and the area had easy, secure parking. Lahoucine, the host, really made a difference to us as he was so responsive, kind, and accommodating. Whenever we needed anything, he was ready to help. Definitely recommend!

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Ghani
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. Adil is an exceptionally polite and kind host, he made sure everything was perfect for my stay and was always ready to help with a smile. I truly appreciated his hospitality and would happily stay here again.

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Othman
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: Absolutely loved my stay! 😍 The apartment is beautiful, spotless, and very comfortable. The location is perfect—right in the heart of Marrakech and close to amazing restaurants. Highly recommend for a perfect stay!” ✨ Thank you mehdi ❤️

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Abdullah
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: I would come back a 1000 times . It felt amazing. Quiet place surrounded with many restaurants, cafes and all what someone needs.

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Imane
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: Séjour très agréable, logement propre et conforme à la description. Hôte accueillant, je recommande 👍

riad-citrus-courtyard.author: Amutha
riad-citrus-courtyard.body: This was a perfect flat for our family of 4 as a stopover before going to airport next day. Well-equipped, clean and nice decor (better than some hotels!). Hamza was an excellent host and very responsive. It’s in a quiet residential block of flats. Well-lit and safe. Easy to use uber when needed. 20min cab to Medina.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: El Mehdi
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: The Airbnb is conveniently located near the airport and accurately reflects the description and photos. There was some noise from children playing outside in the evening, but it quieted down by night. The space is well-equipped. The host was very responsive and accommodating, making the check-in process smooth.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Graham
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: I loved staying here! The breakfast on the rooftop was always amazing, it’s in a great location and I really liked the room I stayed in, it had a lovely design! I’m planning on coming back to Marrakesh sometime soon and this place will be my first choice of somewhere to stay!

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Hafid
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Meine Frau und ich waren rundum zufrieden mit unserem Aufenthalt. Es hat uns dort wirklich sehr gefallen – wir fühlten uns wie zu Hause. Das Zimmer war sauber und gepflegt, und jeden Morgen bekamen wir ein leckeres, traditionell marokkanisches Frühstück serviert. Der Pool war stets sauber und das Wasser klar – wir konnten ihn die ganze Woche über in vollen Zügen genießen. Ein großes Dankeschön an Abdeljalil, den Hausmeister, der uns jederzeit freundlich zur Seite stand. Er half uns mit vielen Tipps, zum Beispiel, wo man am besten essen oder einkaufen kann.…

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Rachid
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: J’ai passé un excellent séjour chez Fatimazahra ! Elle m’a accueilli chaleureusement et a été très attentionnée pendant tout mon séjour. La chambre était propre, confortable et bien équipée, avec tout ce qu’il faut pour se sentir à l’aise. Je recommande vivement son logement à tous ceux qui cherchent un endroit agréable et calme. Merci encore Fatimazahra pour ton hospitalité !

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Saad
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Avoid place at every cost. It is weird neighbourhood, with no shops or restaurant far far away.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Dave
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Khalil was a very hospitable host. He made sure to provide you the necessities. His place is immaculate perfect for backpackers who have flights the next day for his apartment is just literally 10mins walk outside from the airport. Straight out from the airport to your right. I’ll be sure to get back from his place next time I’ve got a flight from Marrakech.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Fahad
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: - Paceful / Peaceful place - Quality - Friendly - pro host / Amazing person .. Definitely its a must in my next visit ✊🏼✌🏽

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Maria Paris
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Wonderful Villa and the rooms are very spacious, the pool is very beautiful too The hosts were very nice I recommend this place , thank you again

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Assia
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Nice place for the price, the staff is kind and respectful. Highly recommended, especially if you want a place with the medina vibes.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Bartosz
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: The landlord was very polite and always helpful. He assisted me whenever I needed anything and made my stay comfortable.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Tanouti
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: The host was nice, welcoming and always available. The place is clean, easy to Access and close to the city center and train station

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Markuss
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: I really enjoyed my time staying in this apartment. Everything was described as it was accurately, the room was spotless and had everything you needed. Ayoub was also very welcoming and was happy to answer all my questions I had about Morcco, and trust me I had a lot 😀.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Youssef
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Your apartment is truly comfortable, and your taste in it is evident. May God bless you and increase you in His bounty." • "I truly felt comfortable, as if I were at home. May God expand your life." • "Your taste is refined, and the apartment is beautifully arranged.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Mawunyo
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: Abdessamad was a wonderful host. The directions he provided made it very easy to find the location, and the room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I had a pleasant stay and would definitely recommend it to others.

villa-bohemian-retreat.author: Nurul Aziza Taqiyya
villa-bohemian-retreat.body: im very very very pleased with this place!! <3 we stayed with hicham's mom but she is so so soooo sweet! the moment we arrived she gave us food such as moroccan pancakes, cookies, fruits, and tea and they were all delicious! she also let us wash our clothes because it was raining so bad and our clothes were dirty (she even hung them for us omg i feel bad but thank you so much). for me the bed was not a problem. one of my friend extended his stay here cause he liked it so much and he also talked with the sister of hicham, they are all nice people.…
